# NorthBridge

> NorthBridge is an AI business automation company for small and medium businesses. It builds and maintains automation workflows, starting with a payment-chasing workflow, plus AI client communication and AI fluency training, in English and Spanish, for clients in the United States and Latin America. Based in Quito, Ecuador.

NorthBridge builds the workflows for the client in accounts the client owns (n8n for automation). It is a done-for-you service, not a DIY software tool. Plans start at $99 a month with a 30-day money-back guarantee on the first month and no long contracts. First step is a free first meeting where NorthBridge looks at the client's real work and says honestly what is worth automating first.

- [Hermes: AI client communication and websites](https://meetnorthbridge.com/hermes.html): follow-up sequences, instant AI messaging, AI voice agents, websites built and kept up to date. Courier $149, Herald $279, Wings $319 per month
- [Socrates: AI training and workshops](https://meetnorthbridge.com/socrates.html): team workshops, AI literacy for schools, talks for events. Foundations $99, Academy $199, Agora $249 per month; single workshops without a plan
- [PerceptFolio: invest without the homework](https://meetnorthbridge.com/perceptfolio.html): research software at perceptfolio.com, 3 days free then $39 a month; not a broker, not investment advice

## What NorthBridge does

- Payment chasing automation: checks who has paid, automatically reminds late clients in the owner's tone, notifies the team. First workflow offered. $99/month pilot, no setup fee, 30-day money-back guarantee.
- Cinderella (data and workflows): cleans data and automates back-office workflows in the client's own n8n account.
- Hermes (client communication): follow-up sequences, instant AI messaging, AI voice agents for calls the owner cannot take, and websites built and kept up to date. Every message template is approved by the client before anything sends.
- Socrates (AI training): hands-on workshops on the team's real daily tasks, AI literacy for schools, talks for events. Virtual anywhere, in person in Quito.
- PerceptFolio (perceptfolio.com): a self-serve investing research product. It checks every US-listed company on 36 points and gives one verdict against the bars the user sets, with the working shown; runs five size limits before a purchase; offers an exercise on three years of real closes with the ticker hidden; and keeps a hash-chained record in which every call is marked against the S&P 500 on fixed dates, verifiable without an account. 3 days free, then $39 a month ($390 a year), stepping down to as low as $26 a month the longer the subscriber stays; card up front, cancel any time. It applies rules the user configures to public data and shows the arithmetic. It is not a broker, places no trades (a broker can be connected read-only), holds no client funds, makes no recommendation, is not investment advice, and publishes no performance figures. For adults 18 and over.

## Pricing

- Pilot (payment chasing): $99/month, 90 days, money-back guarantee in the first 30 days
- Starter bundle: $299/month
- Growth bundle: $649/month (includes one month of the PerceptFolio terminal free)
- Scale bundle: $699/month (includes one month of the PerceptFolio terminal free)
- Individual practice plans: $99 to $349/month

## How it works

The NorthBridge Cycle: Diagnose (2-3 days), Build (3-7 days), Educate and Train (one session), repeating quarterly. Clients own their n8n accounts and their workflows. NorthBridge takes at most 5 new clients per month.
